quarterly_data.quarter: BillionToOne press release: BillionToOne Launches Northstar Origin, a New Liquid Biopsy (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BillionToOne launched Northstar Origin on September 1, 2026: a physician-ordered add-on to Northstar Select that predicts tissue of origin directly from circulating cell-free DNA for patients with cancer of unknown primary or uncertain diagnosis, combining methylation profiling with Northstar Response's single-molecule precision and tissue-specific somatic variants detected by Northstar Select. The supervised classifier was developed on 6,025 blood samples from advanced cancer patients previously sent to its clinical laboratory; in an independent validation cohort of 1,578 patients it named the correct tissue of origin as its top prediction in 87% of cases and within its top three in 91%. The Northstar Select panel expanded from 84 to 102 genes (18 new genes, including MTAP deletion). BillionToOne plans prospective studies to extend the model to additional tumor types.
